message.content: Elara enjoys taking some time to unwind and reset after intense battles. Specifically, she likes to wander around and collect items or engage in side quests that allow her to explore the game world and take in its various features. This downtime is not only relaxing but also serves to level up her characters or experiment with different party combinations, further enhancing her gameplay experience. Elara finds that these activities help her return to the action with a refreshed mindset, ready to tackle future challenges.
